Record the queue length of each switch's port.
Note it's sampling based, and if queue is empty, no record is made to save space.

time [time record] [switch ID] j [switch ifindex] [queue length in Bytes] ...
time 15060000 32 j 9 6216 j 10 6216 j 11 6216 j 12 6216
time 15060000 33 j 9 24864 j 11 6216 
time 15060000 34 j 11 18648 j 12 6216
time 15060000 35 j 10 12432 j 12 18648
